entries.summary: Multi-hot encoding for cells that contain several delimiter-separated items.

recipe.title: Multi-hot encoding for cells that contain several delimiter-separated items.
recipe.code:
import pandas as pd
from category_encoders import MultiHotEncoder
X = pd.DataFrame({'topic': ['math|physics', 'math', 'physics|art', 'art']})
MultiHotEncoder(use_cat_names=True).fit_transform(X)

recipe.title: Count-based target encoding with smoothing-adjusted log-odds.
recipe.code:
from category_encoders import CountTargetEncoder
import pandas as pd
X = pd.DataFrame({'city': ['chicago', 'chicago', 'denver', 'denver', 'denver']})
y = [1, 0, 1, 1, 0]
enc = CountTargetEncoder().fit(X, y)
enc.transform(X)

recipe.code:
from category_encoders import GrayEncoder
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.datasets import fetch_openml
bunch = fetch_openml(name='house_prices', as_frame=True)
display_cols = [
    'Id',
    'MSSubClass',
    'MSZoning',
    'LotFrontage',
    'YearBuilt',
    'Heating',
    'CentralAir',
]
y = bunch.target
X = pd.DataFrame(bunch.data, columns=bunch.feature_names)[display_cols]
enc = GrayEncoder(cols=['CentralAir', 'Heating']).fit(X, y)
numeric_dataset = enc.transform(X)
print(numeric_dataset.info())
